summary: Independent review found TASK-0035 satisfies the Evidence current-set and multi-Claim Defect contract. EvidenceRegistry resolves append-only histories deterministically, Completion consumes the resolved current set, stale or invalid current leaves fail closed, selective verification separates current reuse from historical excluded Evidence, Defects record direct and affected Claims, and independent checks passed.

criteria.criterion: A passed Evidence record that supersedes a prior failed record can satisfy a Claim without deleting the failed history.
criteria.notes: EvidenceRegistry current-set logic excludes superseded failed history while allowing a current passed superseding record to satisfy the Claim. Independent fixture rerun preserved 3 historical excluded Evidence refs and still completed.

criteria.criterion: A stale/revoked/contradicted superseding record leaves the Claim uncovered and blocks Completion.
criteria.notes: Current-set and Completion code check validity/current fingerprint state on current leaves. Tests and inline probe show stale replacement leaves the Claim uncovered and Completion false, without reactivating superseded history.

criteria.criterion: Supersession cycles, self-supersession and unknown refs fail closed.
criteria.notes: Supersession validation rejects duplicate refs, self-supersession, unknown refs, cycles and competing current leaves. Resolution failures clear current records and block completion.

criteria.criterion: Completion consumes the EvidenceRegistry current set instead of a caller-curated tuple.
criteria.notes: evaluate_completion constructs an EvidenceRegistry from append-only evidence_records and calls current_set before evaluating required Claims. Dynamic fixture passes full final_records rather than deleting old Evidence.

criteria.criterion: Selective verification lists current reused Evidence and historical excluded Evidence separately.
criteria.notes: VerificationSelection now emits reusedEvidenceRefs, staleEvidenceRefs, historicalEvidenceRefs and resolutionFailureRefs separately. Independent fixture rerun shows historicalExcludedEvidenceRefs distinct from currentEvidenceRefs.

criteria.criterion: DefectRecord supports one or more direct Claims and one or more affected Claims.
criteria.notes: DefectRecord requires directClaimRefs and affectedClaimRefs, preserves claimRef only as compatibility metadata, and fixture Defect includes one direct Claim plus multiple affected Claims.

criteria.criterion: Affected Claims include deterministic reverse dependency closure or an independently validated equivalent.
criteria.notes: defect_from_result computes affectedClaimRefs through deterministic reverse dependency closure when a ClaimGraph is supplied. Fixture affected claims include the direct failed claim plus dependent completion, repair-boundary and selective-reverification claims.

criteria.criterion: Legacy Evidence remains legacy_partial and cannot silently satisfy M1 Claims.
criteria.notes: Legacy evidence manifest adapter labels old AWKP evidence as legacy_partial with missing v2 fingerprint bindings. Tests verify legacy records remain partial and are not silently promoted into current M1 Evidence.

criteria.criterion: Full checks and migration tests pass.
criteria.notes: Independent full check, AWKP lint, git diff whitespace check, targeted migration tests, fixture rerun, manifest SHA verification and focused current-set probe all passed.
